needs.premise: Three original-owner activations: root ___run and two nested SFUNs; native-only settlement, complete off-stack roots, stopped writers and qualified bridge policy are premises; marker state means logical validity, not actual heap clearing or refcount; no weak-memory, arbitrary library unwind or dynamic-wind simulation
21 conditional declarations: root/init accounting, committed-result preservation, non-target settlement Step/Trace and pop gates; not complete QNT/source simulation or C lifetime/GC proof

Scheme c-make-function/c-function emits guards for void, SCMOBJ and native-result SFUN families before marker allocation; protected entry/result/error roots and typed exit descriptors cover argument/result conversions and conversion-handler reentry; static module entry and dynamic C-closure proc origins differ; no body/END-only placement

Reuse ___run catcher while adding persistent entry record before allocating marker and one outcome funnel after END_TRY; normal/matching return and C error retain existing return-code contract; startup/processor error propagation stays separate from SFUN rethrow; nested external ___run has no automatic admitted profile

Preserve current continuation destination and logical GVM frame coordinate through inner guard and CFUN bridges; never restore abandoned entry fp or invoke winding/destructor callbacks during settlement; only matched ___call consumes target frame; internal UNWIND_C_STACK_TO_TRAMPOLINE trips remain consumed by its loop and never close invocation; original activation/OS thread/processor generation and nonlocal-jump ABI remain mandatory

Root cells and error/result/destination descriptors outlive every escaped C frame; logical activation close precedes pop, actual marker clear/refcount decrement waits exclusive root/heap write permission; return handler validates authoritative activation state without changing processor-hook ordering; queued return requests cannot resurrect closed activations; nonzero RC scan/teardown closure still required

Guard closes bounded writers, publishes exact stopped initialization duty to pre-backed service escrow and preserves already committed wrapper/result right; no replay, rollback, root retirement or ticket refund from exception/unknown response; unknown managed stop/layout refuses admission or fail-stops violated admitted premise, never waits in an owner/GC cycle or fabricates ordinary return

Existing CFUN TRY, W_ALL/R_ALL, argument conversion releases and custom AT_END effects remain caller obligations; qualify every intervening native frame and cleanup origin, settle native temporaries or explicitly transfer permitted duties before propagation; foreign-library continuation escape unsupported without contract, not converted to Tcl success/error by fiat

C memory/lifetime refinement for stable pre-setjmp record handle, canonical result read, activation close/return claim, off-stack root publication, deferred physical marker write/refcount, catcher restore before propagation and generation reuse; acquire/release or locks never make raw racing SCMOBJ reads safe

Capture and lease closure identity before any collecting/reentrant entry; replace process-global c_closure_self for supported concurrent closures with per-invocation identity; TLS alone does not handle same-thread nesting; marker belongs to original activation/processor, invalidity is permanent

Generated C boundary catches each supported nonlocal exit at the original owner activation; stable record pointer predates setjmp, mutable ownership/progress lives outside changed nonvolatile automatic locals; publish error/root or destination marker, stop writers, transfer initialization duty and invalidate escaped markers before propagation; never hold admission lock across allocation/callback/unwind

Completed body and result root precede one canonical pending-to-wrapper control publication carrying invocation generation and release right; field writes and notification are not commit; before commit escrow retains native right, after commit unwind cannot roll it back; authoritative query after unknown response never reexecutes production or commit

All GC/explicit/rollback/teardown release dispatchers consult canonical right; stopped safe-shell initialization may park without owner-return wait; unknown writer/layout/root/commit cannot authorize takeover or refund; native borrowers drain before disposal, result/root/code readers and descendants before metadata/ticket reuse

Actual C release/acquire or lock refinement for physical list/root registration, shell admission, collector root mutation, canonical control and unwind drain; raw body readers excluded until control acquisition; actual builtin setjmp ABI and generation reuse require toolchain-specific evidence

callers.actualChain: c-make-function emits void, SCMOBJ and typed-native BEGIN/ERROR/END families; reorders scheme-object parameters before other conversions
callers.hazard: Guard inside SFUN_BODY misses earlier marker/argument allocation and later result/error conversion
callers.replacement: One enclosing entry/exit plan for all three families; generated adapters retain native result ABI

callers.actualChain: c-function selects module MLBL for c-define, false for dynamic C closure; trampoline stores global self
callers.hazard: Static module/code pin and dynamic closure/root lease have different proof obligations
callers.replacement: Typed ProcOrigin, capture closure before reentry, stable code/RC/root leases

callers.actualChain: SFUN conversion errors write temps then call handler; default handler raises Scheme conversion exception
callers.hazard: Error handler can reenter, escape or return; PSTATE scratch is not durable parent storage
callers.replacement: Protect per-invocation error/result roots and separate transport tag from Scheme handler semantics

callers.actualChain: ___call builds marker frame; wrong marker/error rethrows; only matching unwind advances fp and restores R0
callers.hazard: Restoring inner entry fp destroys outer destination; killing destination marker prevents legal return
callers.replacement: Inner settlement preserves rooted destination/coordinate; matching ___call alone consumes frame

callers.actualChain: ___run catcher catches C throw and returns err; marker kill occurs only on normal call path
callers.hazard: Replacing this with unconditional rethrow changes boundary contract; kill may be skipped
callers.replacement: Reuse catcher, persistent marker-ready state and common post-TRY settlement; code return distinct from resource disposition

callers.actualChain: Child processor ___run error enters OP_PROCESSOR_0_THROW_ERROR collective and then sync service; startup ___run error triggers cleanup
callers.hazard: Native exit guard must not swallow/relabel processor termination or skip final sync participation
callers.replacement: Keep original coordination after guarded ___run returns; no independent-worker or nested-run admission claim

callers.actualChain: cleanup? selects CFUN_BODY_CLEANUP TRY with W_ALL/R_ALL; AT_END and conversion-end releases occur on generator paths
callers.hazard: A new SFUN guard cannot replace intermediate native cleanup or assume AT_END has no callbacks
callers.replacement: Retain or explicitly migrate each temporary/release origin and audit register reload at transport edges

callers.actualChain: make marker can collect before proc copy; kill writes vector[0]=false and decrements still refcount; GC mark_rc is inside P0 branch
callers.hazard: Frozen root view/independent worker cannot be bypassed by old direct marker store or RC addref
callers.replacement: Root before allocation, logical activation close then authorized physical clear; source RC scan/teardown gap retained

callers.actualChain: Wrong-processor return routes through hook; _thread installs migration; invalid marker checked afterward
callers.hazard: Changing check order changes hooks/errors; worker or processor identity alone is not a live original C activation
callers.replacement: Preserve route ordering; owner-local authoritative return claim and generation reject stale/queued requests

callers.actualChain: Continuation winding invokes before/after procedures and uses their continuation/denv
callers.hazard: A native finally callback could duplicate/reorder winds or retarget a packet already selected
callers.replacement: Scheme retains winding; C packet selected at actual native catcher, settlement itself performs no Scheme callback

callers.actualChain: Tcl command calls tcltk_call, Scheme may call tcltk_eval whose error calls tcltk_eval_error c-define; result string handed to Tcl
callers.hazard: This is a real nested callback route but does not prove arbitrary cross-Tcl continuation unwind is legal
callers.replacement: Explicit library-boundary policy, per-invocation root/native-string custody; no fabricated TCL_OK result

callers.actualChain: Server c-define returns string and catches errors in Scheme; memory example passes function-valued hop to C foo
callers.hazard: Source is an actual generator consumer, not a native acceptance run or nested continuation witness
callers.replacement: Use to instantiate typed native-result/function origin profiles; preserve Scheme error-to-string policy
